issue.title: test-command-mode-sheet-sequence-dom production-sheet case times out at 30 s under heavy host load
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-o6.2 (note #2, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-o6 land agent. Not caused by the identity-kit change: it reproduces on a clean pre-epic archive. The test drives a real production sheet render with DOM clicks and has a 30 s wall-clock timeout that heavy parallel suite load exhausts. Consider raising or removing the wall deadline, or gating progress on events like bob-cli-dd.2 did for the command-mode FIFO test.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once (30 s timeout) in a full npm test run on athena at load average 184 during the bob-cli-o6.2 gates (2026-11-20). Passed twice in isolation on the identity-kit tree and once on a clean 36dcf7c archive, so it is load-only and serial runs pass. No fail observed at normal load.
task_type_fields.node_id: scripts/test-command-mode-sheet-sequence-dom.cjs::production sheet render and clicks use real DOM APIs
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: npm test in bob-plugins on athena under heavy load (load average ~184 on 64 cores)

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-o6.2 note #2 recorded this load-only timeout with no open bead tracking it (bob-cli-f1 is closed and covered the missing-Chromium skip, a different defect); filed by the bob-cli-o6 land agent so the flake stops surprising full-suite gates.
